Run the checks in this order.

  ./configure --prefix=/usr/local
  make -j8 -k
  install -m 0755 -o root -g root build/mytool /usr/local/bin/mytool
  setcap cap_net_raw+ep /usr/local/bin/mytool
  mytool --check -v -p 8080

The last line is the one that matters: it exits non-zero when the
capability was not granted.
